Here are a few iPhone project ideas across different categories and complexity levels:

### 1. Everyday Utility & Productivity
* **"Micro-Habit" Widget Tracker:** A minimalist app focused entirely on iOS Interactive Widgets and Live Activities—tap directly on the Lock Screen or Home Screen to log water, stretches, or reading without ever opening the app.
* **Smart Receipt & Warranty Vault:** Scan receipts using VisionKit (`VNDocumentCameraViewController`), extract purchase dates and return windows with on-device OCR, and schedule local notifications before a return window or warranty expires.
* **Voice-to-Structured-Note:** Record a quick rambling voice memo and automatically turn it into a clean checklist or calendar event using Speech Recognition and on-device Foundation Models.

### 2. Camera, Sensors & AR
* **AR Room Measure & Furniture Sketcher:** Use RoomPlan and ARKit to scan a room in 3D and test if a piece of furniture or wall art fits.
* **Golden Hour & Photo Spot Scout:** Combine CoreLocation, WeatherKit, and the compass to show photographers exactly where the sun/moon will align at a given location and time.
* **Workout Rep Counter:** Use the Vision framework's body pose estimation (`VNDetectHumanBodyPoseRequest`) to count push-ups, squats, or yoga holds hands-free.

### 3. Social & Local
* **Offline-First Travel Split & Itinerary:** A lightweight trip companion using SwiftData + CloudKit sharing to split expenses in multiple currencies and pin offline map spots.
* **Bluetooth/Nearby Party Game:** Use the `MultipeerConnectivity` framework to build a local multiplayer trivia or drawing game that works on airplanes or camping trips with zero internet connection.

### 4. Quick Weekend Builds (Great for learning SwiftUI)
* **Custom Pomodoro with Live Activities:** A focus timer that lives in the Dynamic Island and Lock Screen using `ActivityKit`.
* **Soundscape Mixer:** Layer ambient audio tracks (rain, coffee shop, fireplace) using `AVAudioEngine` with custom sleep timers.

No Mac needed! The best way to build for iPhone without a Mac is an **iOS-optimized Progressive Web App (PWA)**. When you tap **Share → Add to Home Screen** in Safari, it launches full-screen with its own icon, works offline, and feels just like a native iOS app—with zero App Store fees.

Here are great iPhone PWA project ideas we can build right here:

### 1. Daily & Personal Trackers (Offline-First)
* **Workout & Gym Log:** Track sets, reps, rest timers (with audio cues), and personal records. Stores data locally on your phone (`IndexedDB` / `localStorage`) with one-tap JSON backup/export.
* **Habit & Streak Grid:** A GitHub-style contribution grid for daily habits, water intake, or reading goals with smooth touch animations.
* **Quick Expense & Budget Splitter:** A fast numpad-first interface to log daily spending by category or split a dinner bill with friends.

### 2. Utilities & Tools (Using Web APIs)
* **Ambient Focus & Sound Mixer:** Combine procedural/looped ambient sounds (rain, white noise, brown noise, cafe) using the **Web Audio API** + a built-in Pomodoro timer.
* **Smart Kitchen Converter & Recipe Scaler:** Scale recipe ingredients up/down, convert units on the fly, and run multiple named kitchen timers at once.
* **QR & Barcode Scanner / Generator:** Uses the iPhone camera (`getUserMedia`) to scan QR codes/barcodes and lets you create custom styled QR codes for Wi-Fi, links, or contacts.

### 3. Games & Pocket Fun
* **Daily Word / Logic Puzzle:** A custom Wordle-style, Sudoku, or tile-sliding game with daily challenges, stats, and shareable emoji results.
* **Pass-and-Play Party Game:** A "Heads Up!", trivia, oravelength/impostor party game designed to be held up or passed around a room with friends.
* **Flashcard & Spaced Repetition Deck:** Swipe-based study cards (Tinder-style swipe right = knew it, left = review again) with custom decks.

---

Which of these sounds fun to build (or do you have another idea in mind)? Once you pick one, I can scaffold the mobile UI and PWA setup so you can install and test it on your iPhone right away.

Here is how the customizable iPhone web app (PWA) would work from start to finish:

### 1. Install It on Your iPhone (Like a Native App)
* Once we host the app (for example, using free GitHub Pages right from this repo), you open the link in **Safari** on your iPhone.
* Tap **Share → Add to Home Screen**. It adds an app icon to your Home Screen and opens full-screen without Safari's address bar.

### 2. Custom Feeds & Sources (Saved Privately on Your Phone)
* **Default Feeds:** Comes pre-loaded with safe public video feeds (like Internet Archive, Wikimedia Commons, and popular video subreddits) so it works out of the box.
* **Custom Source Manager:** Includes a **Sources** menu where you can type in any **subreddit name**, **custom JSON API URL**, or **direct video feed URL**.
* Everything you add is stored strictly inside your iPhone's local browser storage (`localStorage` / `IndexedDB`)—not in the public code repository.

### 3. Pulling & Watching Random Videos
* **Swipe or Shuffle:** Swipe up/down (TikTok/Reels style) or tap **"Shuffle Random"** to pull a random `.mp4` clip from your active sources and play it immediately.
* **Auto-Pull Batch (Offline Vault):** Tap **"Pull 5 Random"** to automatically fetch a batch of random videos and store them inside the app's built-in **Offline Vault** (`IndexedDB`) so you can watch them later even without internet.

### 4. Downloading to Your iPhone Camera Roll or Files
* When you tap **Save to iPhone** on any video, the app downloads the `.mp4` file into memory and opens the **native iOS Share Sheet** (`navigator.share`).
* From that menu, you simply tap **"Save Video"** to save it straight to your iPhone **Photos app**, or **"Save to Files"** to put it in a private folder in the iOS **Files app**.

Adding a source happens right inside the app on your iPhone—no coding required. Here is what the **Sources** screen looks like and how you use it:

### 1. Tap the "Sources" Icon in the App
At the bottom of the screen, you tap the **Sources** tab to open a simple menu with a text box and an **"+ Add"** button.

### 2. Type What You Want to Add (3 Easy Ways)
You can pick which type of source you're adding:
* **By Subreddit Name (Easiest):** Just type the name of any video subreddit (for example, `Unexpected` or `oddlysatisfying`—no full web link needed) and tap **Add**. The app automatically turns that into a feed link and pulls `.mp4` videos from it.
* **By Keyword / Topic:** Type any search word (like `vintage`, `space`, `ocean`), and the app will pull random matching `.mp4` videos from open video archives.
* **By Custom URL / Feed Link:** Paste any JSON feed link or direct `.mp4` URLs into the box and tap **Add**.

### 3. Toggle Sources On or Off Anytime
* Every source you add appears in your list with an **On/Off switch** and a **Delete (🗑️)** button.
* You can turn off the default sources and leave **only your custom sources turned ON**, so when you tap **Shuffle**, it only pulls videos from the sources you chose.
* Everything you type into the Sources menu is saved privately on your phone (and we can even add a **PIN lock** or **"Clear History / Sources"** button if you want extra privacy).

Not *every* random website on the internet, because of two technical rules built into iPhone Safari:
1. **Browser Security (CORS):** Safari blocks web apps from secretly scraping arbitrary websites unless those sites provide a public API or allow cross-site access.
2. **Stream Protection:** Sites like YouTube or Netflix split videos into encrypted chunks rather than a single `.mp4` file, so a browser can't download them directly without a dedicated backend server.

### What We *Can* Build (The Closest Thing!)
We can build a **Multi-Engine Video Search** where typing any keyword searches across the largest open video networks on the internet at the same time and pulls direct `.mp4` files:

1. **Global Reddit Video Search:** Searches across **all of Reddit** (`reddit.com/search.json`) for any video post matching your keyword—giving you access to millions of user-uploaded clips on almost any topic.
2. **Internet Archive (`archive.org`):** Searches millions of free, full-length and short `.mp4` videos by keyword.
3. **Wikimedia Commons:** Searches public media files across the web by keyword.
4. **Webpage `.mp4` Scanner:** A box where you can paste a link to a webpage, and the app will scan that page's code to extract any direct `.mp4` video files it finds.

So when you type a keyword and tap **Pull Random Videos**, the app searches all of those sources at once, grabs random `.mp4` matches, and lets you watch or download them straight to your iPhone.

I have built and saved **ReelVault**, your iPhone Progressive Web App (PWA) for pulling, watching, and downloading random `.mp4` videos from across the web.

### What Was Built
* **[index.html](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html) & [styles.css](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/styles.css):** Mobile-first iOS dark-mode interface with safe-area support for the iPhone notch/Dynamic Island and a 4-tab bottom navigation bar (**Player**, **Search Web**, **Sources**, and **Vault**).
* **[app.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js):**
  * **1-Tap Shuffle & Batch Pull ([`pullRandomVideos`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L482-L566)):** Pull a single random video, pull 5 at once into your queue, or swipe left/right on the video player.
  * **Multi-Engine Web Search:** Searches **Internet Archive** ([`searchInternetArchive`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L218-L276)), **Wikimedia Commons** ([`searchWikimediaVideos`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L279-L315)), and **Reddit Global Video Search** ([`searchRedditVideosByKeyword`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L363-L374)) simultaneously for direct `.mp4` files matching any keyword you type.
  * **Webpage `.mp4` Scanner ([`scanUrlForVideos`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L377-L429)):** Paste a webpage URL or direct video link to scan the page code and extract downloadable `.mp4` files.
  * **Custom Sources Menu:** Add your own **Keywords/Topics**, **Subreddits**, or **Direct/JSON URLs**, toggle any source ON/OFF, or enable the **18+ search filter toggle** in Settings (saved privately in your iPhone's local storage).
  * **Save to iPhone Photos / Files ([`downloadVideoToIphone`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L572-L678)):** Downloads the `.mp4` with a live progress bar and opens the native iOS Share Sheet so you can tap **"Save Video"** (saves straight to your Camera Roll) or **"Save to Files"**.
* **[manifest.json](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/manifest.json), [sw.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/sw.js), & [icon.svg](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/icon.svg):** Full PWA configuration so it installs to your iPhone Home Screen like a native app.

---

### How to Open & Install It on Your iPhone
1. In your GitHub repo (`davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2`), go to **Settings → Pages**.
2. Under **Branch**, select **`main`** (`/root`) and tap **Save**.
3. After ~60 seconds, open `https://davidscottballard1-png.github.io/my-project-2/` in **Safari** on your iPhone.
4. Tap **Share (`⬆️`) → Add to Home Screen** to install **ReelVault** onto your iPhone!

I have updated ReelVault to pull, play, and auto-convert **19 video file extensions** from across the web so they work on your iPhone.

### What Was Added

1. **Expanded Video File Extensions ([`VIDEO_FORMAT_CATALOG`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L11-L31))**
   * **iPhone Native Formats (work by default in Safari & Photos):** `.mp4`, `.mov` (Apple QuickTime), `.m4v` (Apple iTunes video), `.3gp`, `.3g2`, and `.m3u8` (HLS).
   * **Web & Archive Video Formats (with automatic `.mp4` conversion):** `.webm`, `.ogv`, `.ogg`, `.mkv`, `.avi`, `.mpeg`, `.mpg`, `.flv`, `.f4v`, `.wmv`, `.ts`, `.m2ts`, and `.gifv`.

2. **3-Stage Automatic iPhone `.MP4` Conversion Pipeline ([`obtainIphoneReadyVideoBlob`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L455-L534))**
   * **Instant URL & Server Derivative Matching:**
     * `.gifv` links and animated Reddit GIF-video variants are automatically rewritten to direct `.mp4` streams via [`normalizeAndAutoRewriteVideoUrl`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L170-L195).
     * [`searchWikimediaVideos`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L714-L761) queries MediaWiki's `videoinfo` derivatives API to pair `.ogv`, `.webm`, and `.mpeg` files with transcoded `.mp4` streams.
     * [`searchInternetArchive`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L636-L711) pulls `.mov`, `.m4v`, `.webm`, `.ogv`, `.mkv`, `.avi`, `.mpeg`, `.mpg`, `.3gp`, `.flv`, `.wmv`, and `.mp4` files and pairs non-MP4 files with Archive.org `.mp4` derivatives when available.
   * **On-Device WebAssembly Remuxing & Transcoding ([`transcodeBlobWithFfmpegWasm`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L291-L361)):**
     * Uses single-threaded `@ffmpeg/ffmpeg` in the browser to fast-remux (`.mkv`, `.mov`, `.ts`, `.flv`, `.avi`) or transcode (`.webm`, `.ogv`, `.mpeg`, `.wmv`) into `.mp4` (`video/mp4`) with live progress updates.
   * **iPhone Hardware `MediaRecorder` Fallback ([`transcodeBlobWithMediaRecorder`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L364-L452)):**
     * Uses iOS Safari's native hardware `video/mp4` `MediaRecorder` to convert browser-decodable videos into Camera Roll-compatible `.mp4` files when needed.

3. **Format Badges, 1-Tap Convert Button & Format Filter Settings ([index.html](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html#L75-L90), [styles.css](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/styles.css#L240-L263))**
   * Every pulled video displays its format badge (e.g., `MOV • iPhone Native`, `WEBM • Auto-MP4`, `OGV → MP4 ✓`).
   * Tapping **Save to iPhone (Photos / Files)** automatically converts non-native formats into `.mp4` so iOS shows **"Save Video"** for your Camera Roll, or you can tap **🔄 Convert to .MP4** directly in the player.
   * Added format filter and auto-convert controls in the **Sources → Settings** tab ([index.html](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html#L242-L264)) so you can switch between **All Formats + Auto-Convert**, **iPhone Native Only**, or **Strict .MP4 Only**.

Here are some high-impact ideas we could add to **ReelVault** ([index.html](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html), [app.js](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js)):

### 1. 🌐 More Open Video Networks (Zero API Keys Required)
* **PeerTube Global Search (SepiaSearch API):** Search across 1,000+ federated PeerTube video servers for direct `.mp4` and `.m3u8` videos on any keyword.
* **Lemmy & Mastodon Video Feeds:** Pull random viral video posts from Lemmy communities (`lemmy.world`) and Mastodon hashtag feeds, which expose open JSON APIs with direct `.mp4` / `.webm` files.
* **NASA Video Library & Prelinger Retro Archives:** Direct integration with `images-api.nasa.gov` and vintage TV/commercial collections.

### 2. ✂️ Built-In iPhone Video Tools (Before Saving to Photos)
* **Quick Video Trimmer (Start / End Sliders):** If you pull a longer video (e.g., from Archive.org or Wikimedia), trim out a 10–30 second clip and export just that slice as an `.mp4` to your Camera Roll using the existing [`transcodeBlobWithFfmpegWasm`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L291-L361) engine.
* **Extract Audio only (`.M4A` / `.MP3`):** A button to strip just the audio track or sample from a pulled video and save it to iPhone Files.
* **Frame Grabber & GIF Loop Maker:** Save the current video frame as a `.png` to Photos, or convert a short segment into a looping `.gif`.
* **Speed & A–B Loop Controls:** `0.5x`, `1.25x`, `1.5x`, `2x` playback speed pills and a loop toggle on the player card.

### 3. ⚡ Faster Playback & Reels-Style Discovery
* **Background Queue Pre-Buffer & Pre-Converter:** While you watch Video #1 in [`updatePlayerUI`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L906-L977), silently pull and pre-convert Video #2 in the background so tapping **Next ⏭** is instant.
* **Fullscreen Vertical Swipe Mode:** A toggle to expand `#videoStage` ([index.html](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/index.html#L51-L72)) into an edge-to-edge vertical swipe feed (swipe up for next random video, double-tap to save to Vault).
* **Auto-Advance on Video End:** Option to automatically pull and play the next video as soon as the current clip finishes.

### 4. 📥 True Offline Vault & Safari Shortcut
* **True Offline Video Storage in Vault:** Right now [`saveVideoToVaultDB`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L575-L594) saves the video metadata and URL. We can add an **"Offline Cache"** toggle so the actual `.mp4` video bytes are stored in `IndexedDB` for airplane-mode playback.
* **Safari "Send to ReelVault" Bookmarklet / iOS Shortcut:** Generate a 1-tap bookmarklet in the Settings tab so when you're on any webpage in iPhone Safari, tapping it opens ReelVault and immediately runs [`scanUrlForVideos`](https://github.com/davidscottballard1-png/my-project-2/blob/main/app.js#L823-L886) on that page.

Which of these would you like me to build first? (Feel free to pick one, a few, or all of them!)
